verdict.rationale: OpenRouter is an LLM API gateway, and a platform of this kind could plausibly offer scheduled or background jobs, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only request-level features: automatic model and provider fallbacks, tool calling, and a quickstart mention of building agents with tool use, loops and state. Nothing shows a way to configure automations that OpenRouter itself runs autonomously in the background, such as triggers, schedules, hosted agents or background jobs.
